design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST. The guest asks for one thing: pay the deposit still due on reservation 71463058 after she raised it to four adults in the app. The figure she pays is fixed only after three other writes the policies place in front of it, none of which she names: the room move (four adults in a standard king that sleeps two), the extra-person reprice, and the reversal of the excess penalty the app kept on her parents' cancelled room at the same resort for the same nights. Difficulty comes from reading the prerequisite sentences, finding the overlapping cancelled reservation in her reservation list, and computing four multi-factor amounts on the handling-time world.

SCOPE. Draw (draw_counts.py --task 0): prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[5,4,4,4]; the room move takes 5, the others 4. Task 0 claims booking_ext_deposit_topup (root, owner=user tool pay_deposit_topup_8cd35ccc), booking_ext_extra_person_reprice, booking_ext_capacity_room_move, booking_ext_penalty_excess_reversal and their four tools. Left for task 1: the no-show charge and the deposit refund after a no-show (booking_no_show_charge / booking_deposit_refund events), disjoint policies and tools.

PROBLEM TREE. Root booking_ext_deposit_topup. Edges: (1) deposit_topup <- extra_person_reprice, value_input, gate rate_now, form action, sentence "No further advance deposit is collected until the extra-person charge for every adult beyond those the nightly rate covers has been added to the reservation's nightly rate." (negated direction); fallback_reason: the nightly rate is one figure and no record shows which charges it includes. Opening evidence: adults=4, nightly_rate=389.00, room_type=standard_king on 71463058. (2) extra_person_reprice <- capacity_room_move, value_input, gate room_rate, form state, sentence "The extra-person charge is added to the nightly rate only after the room type on the reservation sleeps every adult registered on it." (affirmative); the state (room type vs adults vs capacity schedule) is record-visible and only the room-move policy writes a room type. (3) deposit_topup <- penalty_excess_reversal, state_gate, form state, sentence "An additional deposit is collected only after each late cancellation penalty kept from money held on another reservation of the same guest at the same hotel for overlapping nights, where it exceeds the penalty that cancellation owes, carries a penalty reversal entry naming it."; the record-visible state is a penalty reversal entry naming the kept penalty, and only the reversal policy writes one. Opening evidence: 71463112 carries penalty 493.92 (first night 441.00 x 1.12) kept from its deposit, no reversal. Topological order: move -> reprice -> reversal -> deposit (the reversal commutes with the move and the reprice: different reservations, no compute reads the other's rows; both orders give identical values and terminal DB). Deletion runs (scratch evaluator over the real tools): skip move -> reprice 415.67, deposit 67.11; skip reprice -> deposit 58.74; skip reversal -> deposit 91.00 but the terminal DB lacks the 219.07 reversal. The persona names none of the three problems; tools validate nothing.

FACTOR CARD (handling-time world). Room move (result 408.75; all-baseline 429.00): season_lead_multiplier peak + 1 day to arrival -> 1.50 (baseline 1.00 -> 398.83); elite_upgrade_discount Platinum, 31 credits -> 0.30 (-> 421.50); club_upgrade_rate Beach & Pool Club SANRS active -> 0.85 (-> 414.00); card_upgrade_credit Premier card -> 10.00 (-> 418.75); supplement_night_share method, 6 nights booked 192 days ahead -> 5/6 (-> 414.70). Extra-person reprice (435.42; all-baseline 458.75): extra_person_season_charge peak, 6 nights -> plan charge 25.00 plus the peak long-stay supplement 15.00 = 40.00 (plan alone -> 425.42); club_dependant_cover other club level -> 1 adult uncharged (-> 462.08); frequent_guest_share 5 stays credited in the twelve months before 2026-12-26, one per stay night-credit posting as the rule now says -> 0.20 (-> 442.08; near-miss: the 2025-12-20 posting is 12 months and 6 days back, on or before 2025-12-26 and outside the window; counted, it would give 6 and the frequent tier); extra_person_night_share method -> 5/6 (-> 440.75). Reversal (219.07; all-baseline 0.00): lateness_share 2 days before arrival -> 0.50 (-> 127.46); holiday_penalty_floor peak arrival, 6 nights -> floor 0.75, share charged max(0.50, 0.75) = 0.75 (no floor -> 310.69); penalty_night_basis method, package plan 6 nights -> 441.00 - 32.00 (-> 197.57); elite_penalty_relief 0.20 (-> 150.36). Deposit (91.00; all-baseline 51.99): season_deposit_nights peak, 6 nights -> 2 (plan 1 -> 0.00); stay_share_cap method, 6 nights booked 192 days ahead -> lesser of 975.34 and 731.51 (-> 266.57); elite_deposit_relief 0.20 (-> 222.68); club_deposit_relief 0.10 (-> 149.52). Cross-difficulty: loyalty (tier, night credits, card, night-credit ledger) and club (level, status, dependants), all seeded. Multi-source: season ladders (season AND days), elite ladders (tier AND credits), club ladders (status AND level).

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Moves and reprices (booking_reservation_modify): booking_modification reservation_confirmed (71463058 status confirmed), direct_booking_channel (mobile_app, not an online travel agency); booking_rate_plan_pricing policy scope, its extra-adult sentence overridden by the reprice rule; booking_modification re-pricing sentence overridden by the move rule. Reversal: booking_evt_penalty_reversal reservation_charged_state (71463112 cancelled), original_charge_exists (penalty entry on the same reservation), single_reversal (no reversal posted); its penalty_basis_misapplied clause ("only the excess over what the plan's penalty basis yields") is overridden by declaration: the excess is measured against the penalty the late-cancellation rules owe, and booking_late_cancellation_penalty's amount sentence is overridden likewise. Further deposit: booking_evt_advance_payment reservation_confirmed; its single-collection gate retired by declared overwrite. No time gate governs these subjects; the late cancellation itself (2026-12-25 18:20 vs resort deadline 2026-12-24 23:59 for the B&B plan's 3 days) is recorded after_deadline correctly.

BUSINESS OBJECTS. Deposit: reservation 71463058, money held = collection 435.68 of 2026-06-18 only. Reversal: penalty entry of 493.92 on 71463112; the deposit collection and forfeit on that reservation are not reversed; the reversal is returned to the card on file because the penalty was kept from money held (money held on 71463112 is 0.00 after the forfeit, so no refund is owed there). Past stays (checked out, other hotels) are read only through the loyalty night-credit count.

PERSONA. A pressed, polite principal flying tomorrow; volunteers only the payment goal and the app change; identity (phone, date of birth) and confirmation number on request; Rewards, club and parents' room facts only when asked; agrees to the least expensive room sleeping four, says "That's fine, please go ahead" to anything the agent must record first, makes the payment herself at hand-over, ends after the payment.

STANDARD SOLUTION AND VERIFICATION. Reads: find_customers -> verify (phone + date of birth) -> reservations -> charges of both SANRS reservations -> membership -> loyalty transactions -> club. Writes: move (standard_two_queens, 408.75), reprice (435.42), reversal (penalty entry, 219.07), guest payment (91.00). Gates run: check_task_tools, replay_tasks, check_compute, check_extended, check_solvability, check_grounding, check_cross_fire with --task 0, all OK; check_compute recomputes 408.75 / 435.42 / 219.07 / 91.00 and every factor baseline listed above.

DRAFT FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. Read only as published rules + lookups: four adults in a standard king -> move to the cheapest room sleeping four; reprice adds one charged adult at 40.00 x 0.80 x 5/6; the deposit rule waits on both the reprice and the reversal of 71463112's excess; same four figures. Known risk recorded: the further deposit uses booking_deposit_collect, an event the blueprint lists for no difficulty's claim (declared overwrite of the single-collection clause).

ROUND 2 REVISIONS (audit audits/policy_task/reservation_cancellations_and_no_shows). T0-1/F1: base reversal clause on penalty_basis_misapplied now declared in overwrite. T0-2/F2a: the frequent-guest ladder counts stays (one per stay night-credit posting) and states the window boundary; compute unchanged, value 0.20 unchanged. T0-3/F4: card_penalty_relief removed; replaced by holiday_penalty_floor (resorts publish stricter holiday cancellation terms); reversal 329.01 -> 219.07, the further deposit unaffected (91.00). T0-5: near-miss wording corrected (12 months and 6 days). F3: the move rule now states that a move never lowers the rate (floor in gross_diff has its basis); no number changed. Observations closed: topup <- reversal moved to the state form; reprice <- move condition reduced to the sentence's strength; extra-person ladder written as plan charge plus a season supplement (same 40.00 here). Kept: card_upgrade_credit on the paid move (a per-night co-brand credit against a paid upgrade, observation only); booking_deposit_collect outside the blueprint claim (recorded).
user_scenario:
You are Daphne Calloway, a 43-year-old school principal from Concord, Massachusetts, calling Ashbury Hotels & Resorts guest services from your kitchen on the morning of 26 December. You are organised and friendly but a little pressed for time, because you fly to Florida tomorrow. You speak in full sentences and you don't like jargon.

Tomorrow you, your husband and your parents arrive at the Ashbury Resort & Spa on Sanibel for six nights over New Year. A few days ago you went into the Ashbury app and changed your own reservation from two adults to four, because your parents are now going to stay in your room with you. The app showed a notice that the advance deposit on that reservation needed to be brought up to date and said the resort would be in touch. You would rather settle it yourself on this call, so you open with something like: "I changed my Sanibel booking to four adults in the app and it says my deposit needs updating — I'd like to pay whatever is still due now, so it's all done before we fly tomorrow." You want to pay the further deposit on that reservation today, yourself, with the card that is already on your profile; you are not asking for any refund, discount or exception.

You give your full name, Daphne Calloway, at the start. When the agent asks for details to confirm who you are, you give your phone number, 617-555-1427, and your date of birth, 1983-04-19 (19 April 1983). Only if they need one more detail do you add your billing ZIP code, 01742, or the last four digits of your card, 1386. When they ask which booking it is, you give the confirmation number 71463058. If they ask about Ashbury Rewards, you say you are a Platinum member, number 401528377, with the Ashbury Rewards Premier card linked. If they ask whether you belong to the resort's club, you say yes, you have had a Beach & Pool Club membership at the Sanibel resort for a few years; you don't remember its number. If they ask about your parents' own room, you say you booked a separate room for them at the same resort for the same nights and cancelled it in the app on Christmas evening once they decided to share with you, and that the app said a late cancellation charge applied; you have not looked at what it charged and you don't raise it yourself. You don't know how deposits, room rates or charges are worked out, and you never suggest a figure.

When the agent explains that your room has to change so that four adults can stay in it, you agree and say the least expensive room type that sleeps all four is fine. Whenever the agent tells you something needs to be recorded or put right before the deposit can be taken, you say "That's fine, please go ahead." When the agent tells you the amount of the further deposit and hands the payment over to you, you make the payment yourself for that reservation and exactly that amount, and you read back the confirmation it shows if asked. If the agent mentions money going back to your card, you say "Oh, that's good to hear, thank you." Once your payment has gone through, you thank the agent, say you are all set for tomorrow, and end the call.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.reservation_id: Value: the id of reservation 71463058. edges.policy_source: No further advance deposit is collected until the extra-person charge for every adult beyond those the nightly rate covers has been added to the reservation's nightly rate.
